800.body:
## 🚀 Background Description

The desktop UI (`apps/desktop`) has four waits a user feels, and on a real
workspace all but one of them were slow. Measured on the live catalog behind
the work in #699 — 71,000 provenance records, 39 subagents, 500 workspace
files — with the catalog, artifact-listing, deletion and CAS changes reverted:

| Flow | Scale | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Switch to a Session | 70,000 provenance rows, 500 files | 4.7 s | 2.0 s first visit (1.7–4.1 s across runs), 0.24 s warm |
| Delete a Session | 2,000 messages, 3,000 files | 8.1 s | 70 ms |
| Delete its Project | ten such Sessions | 14.4 s | 304 ms |
| Open a Settings list | empty Project | 17 ms | 16 ms |

Switching sessions took several seconds and the sequence of subagents looked
stuck; deleting a Session or a Project was the request users describe as a
hang. Opening 技能 / MCP 服务器 / 专家 was fast but always drew the dashed
`正在读取…` frame first, so the pane looked like it reloaded from scratch on
every visit — the reason the Settings dialog felt slower than other agent
platforms, whose settings open instantly.

The cause was structural, not a slow query: every write rewrote the whole
catalog, and delete requests reclaimed the Session's data before answering.
Settings panes had no memory: the dialog unmounts a pane when another group is
selected, so every visit started from an empty `useLoaded`.

## Design Ideas

- **Write path (#699).** Stop rewriting the catalog on every write; commit the
  catalog entry and reconcile artifacts behind it.
- **Deletion (#699).** Answer the delete when the catalog commits, then
  reclaim the Session's data in the background.
- **Settings paint (#796).** Keep each page's last answer beside its client
  (`WeakMap<client, Map<key, value>>`, the shape `apps/web/src/settings-cache.ts`
  already uses), seed the pane from it on mount, paint that value, and refresh
  behind it. Keys are per page; the Skills key carries the Project id because
  the enabled set is project-scoped. Pages whose first paint is a form the user
  is about to edit keep the loading gate.
- **Guards (#775).** Store-shape guards, a 10x save-latency ratio, and four
  wall-clock budgets so the regressions cannot come back unnoticed.

Alternatives considered and rejected: optimistic UI for settings writes (the
server owns the value, so a write must be computed from what the server
confirmed); a global spinner-free skeleton (still shows the user nothing on the
first visit); server push for deletions (does not remove the synchronous
reclaim from the request path).

## Involved Public APIs

No public API changes. The HTTP endpoints keep their shapes and semantics; the
only visible difference is timing — a delete response returns after the catalog
commits rather than after full reclamation, and settings list endpoints are read
from a client-side cache for the first paint.

## Description of Relevance to Other Modules

- `services/api` store, catalog, artifact listing and deletion paths.
- `apps/desktop` settings panes (技能, MCP 服务器, 专家) and `useLoaded`.
- `apps/web` — `settings-cache.ts` is the reference shape the desktop copy
  follows.
- Provenance index and workspace scanning, which the first session switch
  reconciles against.

## Test Design and Test Plan

- `services/api/src/performance-budget.test.ts`: the four flows above on a
  fixture (800 messages, 200 runs, 500 files; project case 6 × 200/20/100) with
  budgets of 1 s / 0.5 s / 1 s / 1.5 s. Against the pre-#699 store the two
  deletion cases fail their budgets (1,822 ms and 1,999 ms), so the guards
  would have caught the regression.
- `services/api/src/store-performance.test.ts`: catalog row growth under
  256 B, catalog under 64 KiB, side-table rows, 10x save-latency ratio.
- `apps/desktop/tests/settings-cache.test.tsx`: a remembered list paints
  without the loading frame; one client's list never paints under another; one
  Project's enabled Skills never paint as another's.
- `apps/desktop/e2e/settings-interactions.spec.ts`: holds the `/api/skills`
  response, switches 技能 → 专家 → 技能, and asserts the list is on screen while
  the refresh is still in flight.
- Full gates: `pnpm ci:ut`, `pnpm ci:st`, `pnpm ci:e2e`, `pnpm check`.

## Acceptance Criteria

Measured on the 71,000-record / 500-file catalog above, reverted baseline vs.
current build:

- [ ] Switching to a Session is at least **57% faster** on the first visit
      after a workspace change: **4.7 s → ≤ 2.0 s** (measured 2.0 s, 1.7–4.1 s
      across runs), and at least **94% faster** once warm: **0.24 s**.
- [ ] Deleting a Session (2,000 messages, 3,000 files) is at least **99%
      faster**: **8.1 s → ≤ 0.4 s** (measured 70 ms).
- [ ] Deleting that Session's Project (ten such Sessions) is at least **97%
      faster**: **14.4 s → ≤ 1.0 s** (measured 304 ms).
- [ ] Opening 技能 / MCP 服务器 / 专家 **shows the list instantly and loads in
      the background**: the last answer is painted on mount with no
      `正在读取…` frame, and the refresh replaces it when it lands. This
      scenario did not get faster (17 ms → 16 ms); the acceptance is the
      absence of the loading frame, not a percentage.
- [ ] The four wall-clock budgets in `performance-budget.test.ts` pass, and the
      pre-#699 store still fails the two deletion budgets.
- [ ] Command that must pass: `pnpm test:shared` (full CI plan); for the
      desktop scope, `pnpm --filter @sciencediscovery/desktop test` and
      `pnpm --filter @sciencediscovery/desktop typecheck`.

## Additional Information

Implementation: #699 (merged), guards: #775, settings paint: #796.

---

## 🚀 背景描述

桌面端 UI（`apps/desktop`）有四个用户能直接感受到的等待，在真实工作区上除设置列表外都很慢。以下数据来自 #699 背后的线上规模目录（71,000 条 provenance 记录、39 个 subagent、500 个工作区文件），并把 #699 的 catalog、artifact listing、删除和 CAS 改动回退后测得：

| 场景 | 规模 | 优化前 | 优化后 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 切换会话 | 7 万条 provenance、500 个文件 | 4.7 s | 首次 2.0 s（多次运行 1.7–4.1 s），预热后 0.24 s |
| 删除会话 | 2,000 条消息、3,000 个文件 | 8.1 s | 70 ms |
| 删除该会话所在项目 | 十个这样的会话 | 14.4 s | 304 ms |
| 打开设置列表 | 空项目 | 17 ms | 16 ms |

切换会话原先要好几秒，subagent 序列看起来像卡住了；删除会话或项目就是用户口中"卡死"的请求。打开技能 / MCP 服务器 / 专家本身很快，但每次都会先画一个虚线框的 `正在读取…`，面板看起来像每次都要从头重新加载——这就是设置弹窗比其他智能体平台（它们打开即出现）慢的原因。

根因是结构性的，而不是某条查询慢：每次写入都会重写整个 catalog，删除请求在应答前先回收该会话的数据；设置面板则完全没有记忆——弹窗在切换到其他分组时会卸载面板，所以每次访问都从空的 `useLoaded` 开始。

## 设计思路

- **写入路径（#699）**：不再在每次写入时重写整个 catalog，提交 catalog 条目后由后台对账 artifact。
- **删除（#699）**：catalog 提交后即应答删除请求，会话数据的回收放到后台。
- **设置上屏（#796）**：把每个页面上一次的答案按 client 保存（`WeakMap<client, Map<key, value>>`，与 `apps/web/src/settings-cache.ts` 同一形状），挂载时用它作为初始值先上屏，再在后台刷新并覆盖。key 按页面划分；技能的 key 带上项目 id，因为启用集合是按项目隔离的。首次上屏就是用户即将编辑的表单的页面，仍然保留加载门。
- **守卫（#775）**：store 形状守卫、10 倍保存延迟比例守卫，以及四条墙钟预算用例，防止这些回归悄悄回来。

考虑过但未采用的方案：设置写入做乐观 UI（值归服务端所有，写入必须基于服务端确认过的值计算）；全局骨架屏（首次访问仍然什么都不显示）；删除走服务端推送（并没有把同步回收从请求路径上移走）。

## 涉及的公共 API

不改公共 API。所有 HTTP 端点保持原有形状和语义，唯一可见的差别是时序：删除请求在 catalog 提交后返回，而不是等完整回收；设置列表端点首次上屏时读取的是客户端缓存。

## 与其他模块的关联

- `services/api` 的 store、catalog、artifact listing 与删除路径。
- `apps/desktop` 的设置面板（技能、MCP 服务器、专家）与 `useLoaded`。
- `apps/web` — `settings-cache.ts` 是桌面端拷贝所参照的形状。
- provenance 索引与工作区扫描：首次切换会话仍要与它做一次对账。

## 测试设计与测试计划

- `services/api/src/performance-budget.test.ts`：上面四条流程，fixture 为 800 条消息、200 次 run、500 个文件（项目用例为 6 × 200/20/100），预算分别为 1 s / 0.5 s / 1 s / 1.5 s。回退到 #699 之前的 store 时，两条删除用例会超出预算（1,822 ms 和 1,999 ms），说明守卫能抓住这次回归。
- `services/api/src/store-performance.test.ts`：catalog 单行增长小于 256 B、catalog 小于 64 KiB、副表行数、10 倍保存延迟比例。
- `apps/desktop/tests/settings-cache.test.tsx`：记住的列表不上加载框；一个 client 的列表不会出现在另一个 client 下；一个项目的启用技能不会当成另一个项目的上屏。
- `apps/desktop/e2e/settings-interactions.spec.ts`：挂起 `/api/skills` 的响应，在技能 → 专家 → 技能之间切换，断言刷新尚未返回时列表已经上屏。
- 完整门禁：`pnpm ci:ut`、`pnpm ci:st`、`pnpm ci:e2e`、`pnpm check`。

## 验收标准

以上述 7 万条记录 / 500 个文件的目录为准，回退基线对比当前构建：

- [ ] 工作区变更后首次切换会话至少快 **57%**：**4.7 s → ≤ 2.0 s**（实测 2.0 s，多次运行 1.7–4.1 s）；预热后至少快 **94%**：**0.24 s**。
- [ ] 删除会话（2,000 条消息、3,000 个文件）至少快 **99%**：**8.1 s → ≤ 0.4 s**（实测 70 ms）。
- [ ] 删除该会话所在项目（十个这样的会话）至少快 **97%**：**14.4 s → ≤ 1.0 s**（实测 304 ms）。
- [ ] 打开技能 / MCP 服务器 / 专家时**设置秒出现、后台加载**：挂载即画出上一次的列表，不出现 `正在读取…` 框，刷新返回后再替换。该场景没有变快（17 ms → 16 ms），验收标准是加载框不再出现，而不是百分比。
- [ ] `performance-budget.test.ts` 的四条墙钟预算全部通过；回退到 #699 之前的 store 时，两条删除预算仍然失败。
- [ ] 必须通过的命令：`pnpm test:shared`（完整 CI 计划）；桌面端范围：`pnpm --filter @sciencediscovery/desktop test` 与 `pnpm --filter @sciencediscovery/desktop typecheck`。

## 补充信息

实现：#699（已合入），守卫：#775，设置上屏：#796。

## 🚀 Background Description

The desktop app (`apps/desktop`) does not support scientific memory yet. In the new UI, readers cannot follow a citation in the final report to the evidence or artifact behind it, and cannot configure scientific memory in settings. The old web UI already has the full capability: citations in a report are clickable, evidence and artifacts show their details and provenance, and scientific memory is configurable.

This issue asks for the same capability in the desktop app, without a graph view: after a literature review run (see `docs/zh/domains/literature-research.md`), clicking `[evidenceN]` / `[artifactN]` in the final report opens the evidence/artifact card with its details and provenance.

Related documents:

- Literature research sample: `docs/zh/domains/literature-research.md`
- Scientific memory setup: `docs/zh/advanced-setup/science-memory-setup.md`
- Scientific memory design: `docs/zh/developer-docs/science-memory.md`

## Design Ideas

- **Settings › Scientific memory**: a new settings group with an enable switch, storage backend (local / Neo4j), Neo4j endpoint and user, write-only password, and the current status.
- **Report citations**: `[alias]` tokens in a final report render as clickable chips. A chip shows only the alias the report wrote; no extra "evidence" / "artifact" wording.
- **Press a chip**: open a card with "Details" and "Provenance" tabs.
  - Evidence provenance keeps only the literature source, matching the old UI's `EvidenceModal`: a paper card with title, abstract, and link.
  - Artifact provenance follows the old UI's provenance tab: derived from (parent artifacts / uploaded files), code with script download, execution log (status, exit code, working directory, stdout/stderr, process environment), and managed package environment.
- **Status capsule**: a capsule in the top-right corner reports whether scientific memory is available (available / unavailable / disabled / needs password); pressing it opens the scientific memory settings.
- **No graph canvas**, and no right-rail scientific memory panel from the old UI.
- When scientific memory is off or the sidecar is unreachable, say so explicitly instead of treating the API's `reason` as "nothing was recorded".

## Involved Public APIs

No new server public APIs. The desktop app only reads the existing routes:

- `POST /api/memory/query/by-node-type`
- `POST /api/memory/query/chain`
- `GET/PUT /api/memory/settings`
- `GET /api/health` (the `memoryGraph` status)
- `GET /api/sessions/:sessionId/artifacts/:artifactId/versions`
- `GET /api/sessions/:sessionId/artifact-versions/:versionId/provenance`
- The `references` field on a report version

No breaking change to existing public APIs.

## Description of Relevance to Other Modules

- `services/api`: memory read proxy and settings reads/writes (already present; reused as-is).
- `services/memory-graph`: source of evidence/artifact provenance data (already present).
- Artifact panel and document preview: "Open in the artifact panel" already exists; this feature only calls it.
- Report rendering: desktop rendering of `version.references` into chips (new).
- Provenance semantics must match the old web UI so one feature does not acquire two explanations.

## Test Design and Test Plan

- **Unit tests** (`apps/desktop/tests/scientific-memory.test.ts`, `memory-chips.test.ts`, `api-memory.test.ts`): citation resolution (evidence by id, an artifact pinned to the cited version, a version-less artifact taking the latest, a mismatched label, a kind the graph has no label for); chip URL round-trip, escaping and malformed input; which nodes an evidence source chain shows (deduplicated, the evidence itself removed); the memory query and settings payloads the client builds.
- **Component tests** (`apps/desktop/tests/settings-pages.test.tsx`, plus the card's own states): the 设置 › 科学记忆 pane reads and writes enable, backend and the write-only password; the card's detail and provenance tabs; disabled and unreachable states render a message and a way to the settings pane instead of an empty provenance.
- **End-to-end** (`apps/desktop/e2e/scientific-memory.spec.ts`, mocked memory service and report): open a report → press an `[evidenceN]` chip → details and a single literature card with its abstract → press an `[artifactN]` chip → dependencies, code with script download, execution log and managed environment → open the artifact in the panel; separately, a disabled memory graph, an unreachable chain, and the header capsule driving the settings switch.
- **Regression:** Markdown without `references` renders exactly as before; non-report documents show no chips; the web scientific memory surfaces are unchanged; ordinary sessions keep their text placement and artifact panel.
- **Real journey (L3):** the literature review sample below, run against a real model and search connectors, with the final report's chips followed end to end.
- **Performance and memory, memory off vs on:** on one fixed Session and report (one `[evidenceN]`, one `[artifactN]`), toggle 设置 › 科学记忆 off and on and repeat the same path on the same build: opening the report, pressing an evidence chip until the card is ready, pressing an artifact chip until provenance is ready, and opening the settings pane; report the median of 10 runs. Measure resident memory after idle and after 50 card reads for the memory sidecar, the API process and the desktop renderer, plus the growth of the memory-graph data directory. Take the UI timings against the mocked service (L2) and repeat the end-to-end timings against the real sidecar (L3); record the machine specs and build SHA with the table.

Commands that must pass: `pnpm check` (repo typecheck and unit tests); `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` in `apps/desktop`; the desktop e2e suite (`playwright test --config apps/desktop/e2e/playwright.config.ts`).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The literature research sample in the scientific memory introduction document runs successfully: complete one review from the desktop app following `docs/en/domains/literature-research.md` (Chinese: `docs/zh/domains/literature-research.md`) — configure search, submit the task, obtain a final report whose citations are chips, and open the evidence/artifact card from that report.
- [ ] The UI design passes preliminary review: the 设置 › 科学记忆 pane, the report citation chips, the card's details and provenance tabs, and the header status capsule are reviewed against the agreed design and all review comments are closed.
- [ ] A document without `references`, and any non-report document, looks exactly as it did before the change: no chips and no new controls.
- [ ] The memory off/on comparison is recorded in this issue: medians for opening the report, an evidence card, an artifact card and the settings pane, and the sidecar / API / renderer memory plus the graph directory growth, for both the mocked and real-service runs. No new interaction adds a visible pause, and sidecar memory stays bounded across repeated reads.
- [ ] Commands that must pass: `pnpm check`; `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` in `apps/desktop`; the desktop e2e suite.

## Additional Information

- Old UI references: `apps/web/src/EvidenceModal.tsx`, `apps/web/src/ScientificArtifacts.tsx`.
- The desktop app already has settings groups and dialog components; reuse them rather than introducing a new interaction model.

---

## 🚀 背景描述

桌面端（`apps/desktop`）目前尚未接入科学记忆。用户在新 UI 中无法看到最终报告引用背后的证据与产物，也无法在设置里配置科学记忆；而旧版 Web UI 已经具备完整能力：报告里的引用可点击、证据/产物可查看详情与溯源、科学记忆可在设置中配置。

本次希望把同一套能力带到桌面端，但不引入图谱界面：读者完成一次文献调研（见 `docs/zh/domains/literature-research.md`）后，在最终报告里点击 `[evidenceN]` / `[artifactN]`，即可查看该证据/产物的详情与溯源。

相关文档：

- 文献调研样例：`docs/zh/domains/literature-research.md`
- 科学记忆配置：`docs/zh/advanced-setup/science-memory-setup.md`
- 科学记忆设计：`docs/zh/developer-docs/science-memory.md`

## 设计思路

- **设置 › 科学记忆**：新增配置分组，包含启用开关、存储后端（本地 / Neo4j）、Neo4j 地址与用户、密码（只写）、以及当前状态提示。
- **报告引用**：最终报告的 `[alias]` 渲染为可点击 chip，chip 只显示别名本身，不额外标注“证据 / 产物”等字样。
- **点击 chip**：打开卡片，包含“详情”和“溯源”两个页签。
  - Evidence 的溯源只保留文献来源，与旧 UI `EvidenceModal` 一致：文献卡片展示标题、摘要、链接。
  - Artifact 的溯源沿用旧 UI 产物溯源页：派生自（上游产物 / 上传文件）、代码（含下载脚本）、执行日志（状态、退出码、工作目录、stdout/stderr、进程环境）、受管软件包环境。
- **状态胶囊**：新 UI 右上角以胶囊形式展示科学记忆当前状态（可用 / 不可用 / 已关闭 / 需要密码），点击进入科学记忆设置。
- **不提供图谱画布**，也不再保留旧 UI 右侧的科学记忆框。
- 科学记忆关闭或 sidecar 不可达时给出明确提示，不把接口返回的 `reason` 当作“没有记录”。

## 涉及的公共 API

不新增服务端公共 API。桌面端只读复用现有接口：

- `POST /api/memory/query/by-node-type`
- `POST /api/memory/query/chain`
- `GET/PUT /api/memory/settings`
- `GET /api/health`（读取 `memoryGraph` 状态）
- `GET /api/sessions/:sessionId/artifacts/:artifactId/versions`
- `GET /api/sessions/:sessionId/artifact-versions/:versionId/provenance`
- 报告版本的 `references` 字段

对现有公共 API 无破坏性修改。

## 与其他模块的关联

- `services/api`：记忆读请求代理与设置读写（已有能力，仅复用）。
- `services/memory-graph`：证据/产物溯源数据来源（已有能力）。
- 产物面板与文档预览：从卡片“在产物面板中打开”已有能力，本次只做调用。
- 报告渲染：`version.references` → chip 的桌面端渲染（新增）。
- 与旧版 Web UI 的溯源语义需保持一致，避免同一功能出现两套解释。

## 测试设计与测试计划

- **单元测试**（`apps/desktop/tests/scientific-memory.test.ts`、`memory-chips.test.ts`、`api-memory.test.ts`）：引用解析（按 id 命中证据、锁定报告所引版本、未带版本时取最新、标签不匹配、图谱无对应标签的 kind）；chip URL 的往返、转义与畸形输入；证据来源链保留哪些节点（去重、去掉证据节点自身）；客户端构造的记忆查询与设置请求体。
- **组件测试**（`apps/desktop/tests/settings-pages.test.tsx`，以及卡片自身的状态）：设置 › 科学记忆页读取并写入启用开关、后端与只写密码；卡片的详情与溯源页签；关闭与不可达状态给出说明和进入设置的入口，而不是一片空溯源。
- **端到端**（`apps/desktop/e2e/scientific-memory.spec.ts`，模拟记忆服务与报告）：打开报告 → 点击 `[evidenceN]` chip → 详情与一张带摘要的文献卡 → 点击 `[artifactN]` chip → 派生自、代码与下载脚本、执行日志、受管环境 → 在产物面板中打开；另外验证记忆关闭、链路不可达，以及右上角胶囊驱动设置开关。
- **回归**：无 `references` 的 Markdown 渲染与改动前完全一致；非报告文档不出现 chip；Web 端科学记忆界面行为不变；普通会话的文本归位与产物面板不受影响。
- **真实链路（L3）**：下述文献调研样例，在真实模型与检索连接器上运行，并完整走通最终报告中的引用。
- **性能与内存（开启前后对比）**：固定同一个会话与报告（一条 `[evidenceN]`、一条 `[artifactN]`），在同一构建上分别关闭与开启 设置 › 科学记忆，重复同一条路径：打开报告、点击证据 chip 直到卡片就绪、点击产物 chip 直到溯源就绪、打开设置页；取 10 次运行的中位数。分别记录记忆 sidecar、API 进程与桌面渲染进程在空闲时和 50 次卡片读取后的常驻内存，以及 memory-graph 数据目录的增长。UI 耗时先对模拟服务测（L2），再对真实 sidecar 复测端到端耗时（L3）；表格需一并记录机器规格与构建 SHA。

必须通过的命令：`pnpm check`（仓库类型检查与单元测试）；`apps/desktop` 下的 `pnpm typecheck` 与 `pnpm test`；桌面 e2e 套件（`playwright test --config apps/desktop/e2e/playwright.config.ts`）。

## 验收标准

- [ ] 成功运行科学记忆介绍文档中的文献调研样例：在桌面端按 `docs/zh/domains/literature-research.md`（英文版 `docs/en/domains/literature-research.md`）完整走完一次文献调研——配置检索、提交任务、得到带 `[evidenceN]` / `[artifactN]` 引用的最终报告，并从报告中的引用打开证据/产物卡片。
- [ ] UI 设计通过初步评审：设置 › 科学记忆页、报告引用 chip、卡片的详情与溯源页签、右上角状态胶囊均对照约定设计评审，评审意见全部关闭。
- [ ] 没有 `references` 的文档与非报告文档在界面上与改动前完全一致：不出现 chip，也不新增控件。
- [ ] 科学记忆开启前后的对比已记录在本 issue：打开报告、证据卡片、产物卡片、设置页的中位数耗时，以及 sidecar / API / 渲染进程内存与图谱目录增长，模拟服务与真实服务两组都要有。新增交互不引入可感知的停顿，sidecar 内存在重复读取后保持有界。
- [ ] 必须通过的命令：`pnpm check`；`apps/desktop` 下的 `pnpm typecheck` 与 `pnpm test`；桌面 e2e 套件。

## 补充信息

- 旧 UI 行为参考：`apps/web/src/EvidenceModal.tsx`、`apps/web/src/ScientificArtifacts.tsx`。
- 桌面端已有设置页结构与弹窗组件，可直接复用，避免引入新的交互范式。

802.body:
## 🚀 Background Description

The desktop app (`apps/desktop`) does not support scientific memory yet. In the new UI, readers cannot follow a citation in the final report to the evidence or artifact behind it, and cannot configure scientific memory in settings. The old web UI already has the full capability: citations in a report are clickable, evidence and artifacts show their details and provenance, and scientific memory is configurable.

This issue asks for the same capability in the desktop app, without a graph view: after a literature review run (see `docs/zh/domains/literature-research.md`), clicking `[evidenceN]` / `[artifactN]` in the final report opens the evidence/artifact card with its details and provenance.

Related documents:

- Literature research sample: `docs/zh/domains/literature-research.md`
- Scientific memory setup: `docs/zh/advanced-setup/science-memory-setup.md`
- Scientific memory design: `docs/zh/developer-docs/science-memory.md`

## Design Ideas

- **Settings › Scientific memory**: a new settings group with an enable switch, storage backend (local / Neo4j), Neo4j endpoint and user, write-only password, and the current status.
- **Report citations**: `[alias]` tokens in a final report render as clickable chips. A chip shows only the alias the report wrote; no extra "evidence" / "artifact" wording.
- **Press a chip**: open a card with "Details" and "Provenance" tabs.
  - Evidence provenance keeps only the literature source, matching the old UI's `EvidenceModal`: a paper card with title, abstract, and link.
  - Artifact provenance follows the old UI's provenance tab: derived from (parent artifacts / uploaded files), code with script download, execution log (status, exit code, working directory, stdout/stderr, process environment), and managed package environment.
- **Status capsule**: a capsule in the top-right corner reports whether scientific memory is available (available / unavailable / disabled / needs password); pressing it opens the scientific memory settings.
- **No graph canvas**, and no right-rail scientific memory panel from the old UI.
- When scientific memory is off or the sidecar is unreachable, say so explicitly instead of treating the API's `reason` as "nothing was recorded".

## Involved Public APIs

No new server public APIs. The desktop app only reads the existing routes:

- `POST /api/memory/query/by-node-type`
- `POST /api/memory/query/chain`
- `GET/PUT /api/memory/settings`
- `GET /api/health` (the `memoryGraph` status)
- `GET /api/sessions/:sessionId/artifacts/:artifactId/versions`
- `GET /api/sessions/:sessionId/artifact-versions/:versionId/provenance`
- The `references` field on a report version

No breaking change to existing public APIs.

## Description of Relevance to Other Modules

- `services/api`: memory read proxy and settings reads/writes (already present; reused as-is).
- `services/memory-graph`: source of evidence/artifact provenance data (already present).
- Artifact panel and document preview: "Open in the artifact panel" already exists; this feature only calls it.
- Report rendering: desktop rendering of `version.references` into chips (new).
- Provenance semantics must match the old web UI so one feature does not acquire two explanations.

## Test Design and Test Plan

- **Real sample**: run the literature research sample in `docs/zh/domains/literature-research.md`, then check the citation chips in the final report, the card details and provenance, the header capsule, and the settings round trip.
- **Functional regression**: Markdown without `references` is unchanged; non-report documents show no chips.
- **Error paths**: scientific memory disabled, sidecar unreachable, and a cited node that no longer exists.
- **Automated checks** (under `apps/desktop`):
  - `pnpm --filter @sciencediscovery/desktop typecheck`
  - `pnpm --filter @sciencediscovery/desktop test`
  - `pnpm --filter @sciencediscovery/desktop build`
  - Desktop E2E: `playwright test --config apps/desktop/e2e/playwright.config.ts`
- The real sample needs a real model and search connectors, so it is an L3 journey; run it in a real environment and record the result.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. Successfully run the literature research sample in the scientific memory introduction document;
2. The UI design passes the preliminary review.

## Additional Information

- Old UI references: `apps/web/src/EvidenceModal.tsx`, `apps/web/src/ScientificArtifacts.tsx`.
- The desktop app already has settings groups and dialog components; reuse them rather than introducing a new interaction model.

803.author: yuanzhou75
803.body:
## Background Description

ScienceDiscovery users need to move a completed research conversation to another project or installation and continue working without losing the information behind its messages and results. They also need to start an independent conversation from an intermediate reply without changing the original conversation or inheriting later research as if it already existed.

The required outcome is reliable research handoff and conversation continuation: necessary and complete `.sdresearch` packages export successfully, imports restore the declared content and its relationships, and users can continue chatting or branch from an intermediate reply. The imported research must remain inspectable after restart, with explicit scope limitations instead of broken navigation or unrelated runtime errors.

PR #498 is the implementation intended to resolve this issue. This issue defines the user requirements and acceptance boundary; it is not a roadmap starting after that PR.

## Design Ideas

### Necessary and complete exports

- Both profiles retain all visible messages of the selected conversation scope and their order.
- Necessary export retains current artifact versions, required input versions, relevant workspace files, execution/code/log evidence, and the related review, trajectory and scientific-memory information required by its declared scope. Optional historical records may be omitted explicitly.
- Complete export retains the available history within the selected scope. Full trajectory and full scientific-memory options remain explicit; do not imply that the profile automatically includes every optional detail.
- Preserve selected contents, dependency relationships and omissions in the package. Re-exporting a necessary import as complete must not invent previously omitted history.
- Export previews must reflect the selected revision and options. Background export status and download remain discoverable after navigation/reload; stale output must not be presented as the current package.

### Import and continue chatting

- Inspect and validate the package before restoring its declared files and records. Restore messages, artifact/file versions, execution logs, available trajectory details and provenance with consistent identity mapping.
- Keep the imported evidence snapshot read-only. Provide a visible **Create a new session to continue research** action that creates an independent writable conversation with the retained history and materials. The user must be able to send a follow-up and receive a normal response in this copy.
- Use the receiving installation's model, Runner and permissions. Do not restore credentials or reuse historical permission grants. Missing local configuration produces a specific, actionable state rather than an internal error or silent loss of imported context.
- Original content, file names, timestamps and version relationships must remain attributable. Missing historical evidence must be described as unavailable or omitted, not replaced by the latest file.

### Start an independent conversation from an intermediate reply

- A completed assistant reply in an eligible writable conversation exposes **Branch to a new chat**.
- The branch includes the conversation prefix through that reply and the historical files/evidence attributable to that boundary; later messages and later versions must not leak into it.
- For an imported read-only snapshot, first create the writable continuation, then branch at the chosen historical reply. Explain this path clearly rather than presenting a nonfunctional branch action.
- The branch can accept new messages, preserves a persistent link to its immediate source reply, and never changes the source conversation. A branch can itself be branched with the same rules.

### Integrity and recovery

- Validate content hashes, archive paths and reference relationships. Reject malformed packages before they become accessible research sessions.
- Make import/continuation/branch operations retry-safe. Busy source conversations are rejected clearly; failed operations do not expose writable half-restored sessions.
- Preserve status across navigation and reload. On interruption or service restart, report a recoverable or failed state explicitly rather than claiming completion.
- A package that never contained scientific memory must not fail solely because the graph service is unavailable. If a package contains a graph that cannot be restored, retain an explicit incomplete/blocked state and do not present the research as fully restored.

Alternatives not selected: trajectory-only export; allowing edits to the imported evidence snapshot; replacing missing historical files with current bytes; copying credentials; or branching by copying the current workspace regardless of the selected reply.

## Involved Public APIs

Use the project/session-scoped research-package inspect, preview, export/status/download, import and import-eligibility operations, continuation operations, and conversation-branch/source-navigation operations implemented by PR #498. Exact route names and schemas are owned by its HTTP and client contracts.

Reuse session, message, workspace-file, artifact/version, provenance, execution and trajectory APIs for inspection and follow-up conversations. All reads and mutations remain subject to project/session authorization and snapshot read-only guards. Retrying a mutation must not create duplicate restored or branched sessions. Existing ordinary-conversation behavior must remain compatible.

## Description of Relevance to Other Modules

| Module | Responsibility in this issue |
| --- | --- |
| `packages/research-package` | Archive/manifest, profiles, content checksums, inspection and format compatibility |
| `packages/schema` | Snapshot, continuation and branch contracts; shared read-only state |
| `packages/cas`, workspace and artifact versioning | Restore exact retained bytes and historical relationships without latest-version substitution |
| `packages/trajectory` | Preserve selected indexes and detail payloads so imported history remains inspectable |
| `services/api` package/snapshot/history/continuation/branch modules and store | Scope selection, identity mapping, restoration checks, operation lifecycle, read-only enforcement and source lineage |
| `services/memory-graph` | Export/restore selected scientific memory or summary and report unavailable restoration accurately |
| `apps/web` package controls, conversation controls, workspace/trajectory viewers | Export/import, continuation, branching, progress, file inspection, omission and error states |
| Existing agent/executor and model configuration | Receive the restored conversation context and run new follow-up turns using local settings |

Do not duplicate authoritative session state in the UI. Do not create a new agent loop or execution system for imported conversations.

## Test Design and Test Plan

These are required tests, not claims of existing passing results. Use the exact candidate SHA and isolated source/destination data directories.

### Unit and component tests

- Fixture: one source conversation with multiple visible turns, three artifact versions, input/code/image/text files, successful and failed executions, review evidence, trajectory details and scientific memory. Include a historical artifact dependency from another session.
- Verify necessary vs complete selection, independent trajectory/graph toggles, correct dependency closure, all visible messages, and persistent omission disclosures after repeat export.
- Verify unsafe paths, duplicate entries, damaged/missing objects and unsupported formats are rejected; imported identifiers and references remain consistent.
- Verify all snapshot write paths reject mutation, continuation retries are idempotent, branch boundaries exclude later messages/evidence, and source links survive restart.
- Verify revision-aware previews, pending/stale states, background operation tracking, original-name downloads, file previews and explicit historical omissions.
- Verify restored trajectory detail resolution and scientific-memory summary/full-graph states. Do not claim unavailable records are present.

### End-to-end user journeys

| Journey | User steps | Required result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Necessary handoff | Export necessary → import into a clean destination → inspect messages, final files, code/logs and available provenance | Retained content matches the source; omitted history is explained and does not cause broken-session errors |
| Complete handoff | Export complete with full options → import → inspect old versions, execution history and trajectory/graph details → restart | Selected retained history and relationships remain readable and correct |
| Continue an import | Import → create writable continuation → send a follow-up requiring an inherited fact and file → inspect reply/new output | The agent receives the retained context and can use inherited materials; original snapshot remains unchanged |
| Branch midway | In the writable continuation select an intermediate completed reply → branch → send a follow-up → return to source | Correct prefix and historical evidence; no later content; independent response and persistent source navigation |
| Branch again | Branch an existing branch → restart → navigate to its immediate source | Correct lineage and independent content after restart |
| Background and retry | Start export/copy → navigate/reload → reopen progress → retry an uncertain request | No duplicate sessions, no focus theft, correct status and downloadable result |
| Failure and configuration | Use damaged package, busy source, interrupted copy, missing model configuration, unavailable graph with/without graph payload | Specific actionable states; no falsely completed or writable partial restore; valid packages without a graph are not blocked by graph absence |
| Isolation and repeat export | Modify a copy/branch → inspect originals → re-export/import the copy | Source unchanged, retained evidence correct, inherited omissions preserved |

Browser journeys use the pinned Playwright environment, the shipping executor, isolated services and numbered step reports. Add external-client API/local-stack coverage for restoration and access contracts; internal unit tests are not substitutes for these journeys.

A deterministic mocked-model journey must verify that inherited context/files actually reach the follow-up path, not merely that a send request succeeds. Before acceptance, run a bounded real-model journey covering import → continue → follow-up and intermediate branching; missing credentials are a reported coverage gap, not a pass. Protect private data in reports.

Run the required implementation gates (`pnpm build`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm architecture:check`, `pnpm ci:ut`, `pnpm ci:st`, `pnpm ci:e2e`) and applicable repository checks and targeted journeys on the exact candidate. Report planned/executed/passed/failed/skipped counts, blocked prerequisites and baseline attribution. This issue edit does not execute product tests.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Necessary and complete packages export and import successfully with accurate profile/option previews and explicit omissions.
- [ ] Retained messages, files, versions, execution logs, trajectory details, reviews and scientific-memory relationships match the declared source scope after import and restart.
- [ ] Imported records open without internal errors or unexplained broken references; genuinely missing/omitted data is distinguished from restoration failure.
- [ ] A user can create an independent writable continuation and receive normal follow-up responses using the retained conversation context and files.
- [ ] A user can branch from an intermediate completed reply in a writable conversation, continue independently and navigate back to the source reply; later research is excluded.
- [ ] Originals remain unchanged; retries, interruption, busy sources, unavailable services and missing local configuration have explicit outcomes without exposing incomplete writable sessions.
- [ ] UI review covers export/import, necessary/complete scope, continuation, intermediate branching, progress and failure/omission states.
- [ ] Required gates and relevant browser/API/local-stack journeys are reported for the exact candidate, with no unreported coverage presented as passing.

## Additional Information

Implementation: PR #498.

The completion boundary is evidence export/import, correct restoration, conversation continuation and intermediate branching. Environment recreation, automatic experiment reruns, numerical comparators, paper-target management and scientific failure diagnosis are **outside this issue**. Neither profile claims a reproduction guarantee.

806.body:
> 本 issue 是 [#799](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/issues/799)（英文版）的**中文跟踪版**，供中文读者讨论；技术细节以英文版为准，两者同步更新。关联：英文版 #799 ｜ 上游相邻 issue：#582（输入 token 分析）、jiuwenswarm#6683 / #7101 / #9938。

## 🚀 背景描述

**起点——用户今天实际要等多久**。装机器上，会话首条消息耗时 **~60–135s**（我方 Windows 桌面端跟踪实测：典型 ~85s，全新安装冷启 ~135s），而同会话第二条仅 **~6s**。无论哪种启动口径（全新首启 / 热启动 / 运行中开新会话），首条税都在。

**税的构成**（日志逐行对时分解，开发栈 + 现场取证）：

| 段 | 大小 | 归属 | 机制 |
|---|---|---|---|
| MCP catalog 冷启动 | **~48s**（热后归零） | **SD 侧** | 内置 stdio MCP 进程在 catalog 首次刷新时才拉起并枚举工具；全新安装把这次刷新推迟到首条消息。本机实证：启动时预热 → 首条此段为 0 |
| SD 侧 run 准备链 | **~14s** | SD API | 每轮 run 前的串行 RPC 链（`skills.list` ×3 + 权限更新 + MCP 重注册）+ API 受理（~4s） |
| 会话装配 | 热态 **~5.3s**（0015 补丁前 ~17s） | JiuwenSwarm | 每会话 `create_instance`；0015–0017 已把 ~5.2s import 税挪出该路径 |
| 工具 schema 处理 | **每轮 ~7–8s** | 上游默认 | 每次模型调用全量携带 ~72 个工具定义 ≈ 2.8 万 token（`progressive_tool_enabled=false`；#582 同口径实测） |
| 模型网络/TTFT + 机器税 | 其余 | — | 真实模型耗时、冷机文件读取、杀软扫描 |

**"26.09s"该放在哪**（本 issue 初版错误地拿它当起点）：它是**解剖锚点、不是用户-facing 起点**——开发栈上"目录已热 + mock 模型"条件下的首条耗时（对照第二条 8.67s）。它唯一的用途是给各段定归属：证明 48s 在 SD catalog（JW `reconcile` 只连 1 个本地回环服务器，毫秒级）、量出 SD 侧准备链大小。若拿它当基线，会把真实问题少算一个目录段和模型时间。

**终点（预期值，待装机 A/B 替换）**。全部方案落地后：热启动口径首条 **6–10s**（现状 ~60–135s），第二条 ~5s（现状 ~6s），冷装机首条不再带 ~48s 目录税。**总优化空间：首条省 ~50–120s + 每条再省 ~3.5s**。

## 设计思路

按实测价值排序。已被测量证伪的选项一并记录，避免重复讨论。

1. **S1 —— agent-ready 后立即预热 MCP catalog**（壳层已实现，PR 随附）。
   壳的 `watchAgentReady` 已在探测 `/agent/info`；`jiuwenswarm.reachable` 一变真即在后台发起 `GET /api/mcp/sources`——与 MCP 设置页的 refresh 是同一个请求。stdio 进程拉起与工具枚举由此与用户看"就绪界面"的时间重叠。尽力而为：失败只写 `shell.log`；若预热输了竞速，run 路径会重跑同样的步骤，行为不分叉。
   直接证据：catalog 启动时预热 → 3 分钟后首条该段为 **0**。

2. **S3 —— 精简控制面 API 的每轮准备链**（计划，目录已热场景下剩余价值最大）。
   `executeAgentRun` 头部在 `chat.send` 前对 JiuwenSwarm 跑串行 RPC 链：`skills.list` ×3（解剖锚点合计 ~4s）、权限更新、每轮 MCP 重注册（~1–2s）。候选：skills 列表缓存（技能集变化时失效）、三次 list 合并、API 证明"工具表未变化"使 adapter 跳过注册往返。准备链幂等后，会话创建时预热也在考虑范围。

3. **J2 —— 渐进式工具暴露**（需上游讨论；JiuwenSwarm 原生）。
   `DEFAULT_PROGRESSIVE_TOOL_ENABLED=False` 使每次调用全量携带 ~72 个工具 schema（~2.8 万 token；mock 端点下占每轮 ~7s——即非模型耗时）。启用现成的 `ProgressiveToolRail` 并配少量 direct 白名单，可把**每轮**输入 token 砍掉约 3 倍。上游切入点：该常量的注释/docstring 已写 "enabled by default" 而代码返回 `False`——低争议入口。翻默认值前必须做真实任务召回率验证。

4. **J3 —— 会话装配 warm pool**（第二批）。
   扩展现有 `AgentWarmPool`，会话创建时预建 adapter；实测剩余价值 ~5.3s → 命中 ~1–2s，必须无缝兜底回今天的全量路径。

**已被测量证伪（存档以免重议）：**
- *J1 —— JW 侧 MCP 并发连接+超时*：JW 侧 reconcile 只开 1 个本地回环服务器（毫秒级）；48s 在 SD catalog。仅留作小型上游卫生提案。
- *S2 —— adapter lifespan 预注册*：工具表由控制面 API 每轮组装后经 `/agent/runs` 交给 adapter；adapter 启动时刻无表可预热，空表预热反而迫使首跑换代重注册。

## 涉及的公开 API

- 现有：`GET /api/mcp/sources`（MCP 设置页 refresh 端点；壳层 agent-ready 后也调用）。
- S1 无新 HTTP API / IPC / 配置面。S3 可能为 skills 缓存增加内部失效信号，其 PR 会列明。

## 与其他模块的关系

- `win_desktop`：壳 `watchAgentReady` 预热挂点 + `first-chat-warmup.ts`（新增，有单测）。
- `services/api`：S3 目标——`executeAgentRun` 头部、`jiuwenswarm-skills.ts` reconcile 链。
- `services/adapter`：`ensure_shared_tools` 本就有工具表 diff；S3 可使其走上"未变化"快速通道。
- JiuwenSwarm 补丁：S1/S3 不需要新补丁；J3 落为 0020+（编号与并行打包工作流协调）。
- `apps/desktop`：无 UI 变化；就绪屏时序不变。
- #582：互补——J2 直接针对该输入。

## 测试设计

- **S1（已在分支）**：URL/头部构造与超时单测（`win_desktop/test/first-chat-warmup.test.ts`）；壳全量 116/116 绿；`win_desktop` 构建干净（esbuild + tsc）。
- **集成 A/B**（每改动，D5 测量纪律）：dev 栈 + 本地 mock OpenAI + `agent_server.log` 逐行分段；基线与改动须在**同一主机负载窗口**内测量（并行打包构建会使绝对值失效）；新会话首条 vs 同会话第二条，3 轮取中位。
- **冷场景验证**：catalog 强制为冷（全新数据目录）时，确认壳预热在人类可感的首条消息前完成，且首个 run 不再含 stdio 拉起段。
- **回归**：壳构建 + 全量壳测试；S3 后 `pnpm test`（api 包）；触及补丁时 JW 冒烟（gateway/agentserver/主对话/记忆）。
- **装机验证**：GUI 交互安装（项目纪律，不用 `/S`），三档启动（全新首启/热启动/attach）+ 首响计时，第二条不回退。

## 验收标准

807.author: qingkwl
807.body:
### 🚀 背景描述

Windows 桌面端安装包体积在 f26 基线为 **797.6 MiB**（`836,309,864 B`）。载荷审计（逐包 import 扫描 + 反向依赖链溯源，证据见下）确认约 **1.2 GB 未压缩死重**：从未被运行时代码引用的依赖包、被 extras 带入的巨无霸二进制（claude.exe 237 MB、codex 工具链 ~437 MB、playwright driver 88 MB、uv.exe 49 MB）、lint 组开发工具（mypy/ruff/pylint ~40 MB）、chromadb/jinja2/a2ui 的传递依赖（kubernetes 37 MB、onnxruntime 42 MB、babel 32 MB、google_adk ~20 MB），以及 5 个 Python 服务 env 之间的大量重复依赖（pydantic/fastapi/uvicorn 等各存 5 份）。

本 issue 记录已实施的体积优化（f26 → **578.0 MiB，-27.5%**，终版 release4），与剩余可选项。全部四波（W1 砍死重 / W2 合并 env / W3 版本对齐 / W4 门禁+locales）已完成。硬约束（owner 拍板）：**离线双击即用、首启零网络下载、首启不变慢**；W15 已决案的全量 pyc 预编译不触碰。

### 设计思路

分波次实施，每波独立出包、独立验证、可单独回退：

**W1 砍 JW 死重 + codex vendor（已完成，-214 MiB → 613.4 MiB）**
0. 口径说明：以下 MB 均为**未压缩载荷**口径；安装包是 7z 压缩口径（f26 整体留存 29.6%）。本波未压缩 -1041 MB，安装包 -184 MiB（被砍部分实测有效留存 18.6%——被砍内容以 claude_agent_sdk 的 .py 源码为主，压缩率好于载荷平均）。
1. `scripts/jiuwenswarm.sh`：`uv sync` 加 `--no-default-groups`（lint/test 组不进运行时 venv，**实测贡献 ~40 MB**：mypy 12+mypyc 5+fb62009__mypyc.pyd 19+pylint/astroid/codespell 等）；顺带修复 `jw_bin` 硬编码 POSIX `bin/` 导致 Git Bash 下 setup 不通的问题（按存在性自适应 `Scripts/`）。
2. claude/codex extras 收口（**本波大头**）：新鲜 `uv sync` 本就不装 extras，旧树是 `--all-extras` 历史遗留——实测新旧 venv diff，`claude_agent_sdk` 238 MB 不再安装（JW `external_cli_runtime` 以 `find_spec` 软检测，缺失=界面显示未安装，优雅降级）；playwright 104 MB 随之由 0018 正式移出主依赖。两步骤叠加实测 venv 1578→895 MB。
3. 新增 `win_desktop/scripts/lib/payload-slim.mjs`：assemble 阶段按白名单清扫 uv 无法排除的传递依赖（kubernetes/onnxruntime/babel/google_adk/mypy 系/claude_agent_sdk/playwright/uv 及 venv Scripts 启动器），全部规则带来源注释 + 单测（5/5）；backstop 哲学——新树不装、旧树扫掉。
4. assemble 剔除 `@openai/codex` 的 vendor 原生工具链（~437 MB 未压缩）：实测 SDK import 时不触二进制（`Codex` 类构造时才 resolve），api 启动不受影响，仅 codex specialist 用时报错。
5. JW 补丁链新增 `0018-desktop-slim-deps`：pyproject 主依赖移除 `playwright`/`uv`（uv.lock 重生成入补丁，链 13→15），`huawei_selectors.py` 顶层 import 改 try/except 降级为 `Any`（-156 MB；全部运行时调用点已验证函数级懒 import / pip 兜底）。

**W2 五服务 env 合并为 uv workspace（已完成，-30 MiB → 583.3 MiB）**
1. 仓库根新建虚拟 workspace（`[tool.uv.workspace]`，members=5 服务），5 个 per-service `uv.lock` 删除，统一 lock 解析 68 包，冲突全部「约束交集内就高」（fastapi 0.162 / websockets 17.4 / pydantic 2.14 / numpy 2.5.4 / pandas 3.1）。
2. `start-stack.mjs`：5 次 per-service sync → 单次 workspace sync（含 evolve candidates extra），四个服务 python 全部指向 `envs/sd-services`。
3. `bootstrap.ts` `venvNames` → `["sd-services"]`；`assemble-backend.mjs` `VENV_NAMES` 同步；载荷 envs-template 525.3→423.7 MB。
4. 取舍说明（F10.9「不合并 venv」原则的再评估）：就高统一后唯一硬冲突是 websockets（JW cap `<16`），走 W3 patch 处理；单 venv 意味着任一服务升依赖需全量回归，已接受。

**W3/W4（已完成，release4 = 578.0 MiB）**：JW patch 0019 版本对齐——websockets cap `<16`→`<18`（实测 17 被 google-genai `<17` 钉死；全部调用点审计确认自带 legacy→新 API 回退，故 lock 维持 15.0.1 零行为变化）、numpy/pandas 与 workspace 对齐（2.5.4/3.1.0）。跨 venv 同内容实测 59.9 MB，但 7z 固态压缩的窗口机制 + venv 隔离使硬链接去重对安装包体积无效（证伪后关闭，避免工程质量浪费）。assemble 新增四道门禁：JW 预编译失败改硬失败（根治「载荷 pyc 静默跳过」）、载荷 import 自证（A1）、RequiredFiles 清单（A2）、尺寸常显（A4）；Electron locales 由 55 个 pak 裁到 3 个（en-US/zh-CN/zh-TW，afterPack 钩子）。剩余可选杠杆（待拍板）：evolve candidates extra 不进出包（再 -~25 MiB，/evolve 不可用）、飞书渠道 lark_oapi 95 MB、imageio_ffmpeg 84 MB/matplotlib 23 MB 引用审计。

### 涉及的公开 API

无。全部为打包/构建链改动（assemble、setup 脚本、JW 补丁链）与桌面壳内部路径（bootstrap env 变量）。裁剪后变为不可用的能力：claude CLI 运行时、codex specialist、2 个浏览器类 skill 的抓取函数、JW 自升级/扩展安装的 uv 加速（均有 pip/提示兜底），均非首启与主对话链路。

### 对其他模块的相关性描述

- `scripts/`：jiuwenswarm.sh（setup 参数）、start-stack.mjs（envs 解析）、lib/stack-platform.mjs（修复 `.cmd` spawn EINVAL，Node ≥20.12 CVE-2024-27980）。
- `win_desktop/scripts`：assemble-backend.mjs（清扫接入）、新增 lib/payload-slim.mjs + test/payload-slim.test.ts。
- `win_desktop/src`：bootstrap.ts（venvNames、PAPER_PYTHON_PATH）。
- `jiuwen_swarm/patches/workswarm0.2.6/`：新增 0018-desktop-slim-deps.patch（manifest 15）。
- 服务源码 `services/*/src` 零改动；唯一 JW 源码改动是补丁内 2 个 skill 脚本的 playwright 降级。

### 测试设计与测试计划

- 单测：`win_desktop` 壳测试 118/118（新增 payload-slim 5/5；bootstrap fixture 重建为共享 venv 布局）。
- 服务测试：gateway 30/30、paper 2/2、memory-graph 109 过（78 error 均为「needs a live Neo4j」环境依赖，既有）、evolve 335 过 33 失败——**与 f26 基线树逐一对照完全一致**（Windows 无沙箱既有问题，零回归）。
- 全链冒烟：start-stack（共享 venv）起栈，adapter /agent/info 返回 `reachable: true`。
- 载荷抽查（每波）：死重 7/7 不在、JW pyc 29087 全量、补丁 manifest 15 含 0018、活包保留（numpy/pandas/transformers/chromadb/faiss/lark_oapi/openjiuwen）。
- 出包实测：v0.2 = 613.4 MiB；v0.3 = 583.3 MiB；release4 = 578.0 MiB（安装包数字均为实测）。

### 验收标准

- [x] f26 797.6 MiB → release4 ≤ 600 MiB（实测 578.0 MiB，-27.5%）
- [x] 死重包在载荷中逐一复查不存在（7/7），活包全保留
- [x] pyc 预编译全量落盘（29908→29087 个，W15 首启加速不受损）
- [x] 全链冒烟通过（adapter↔JW reachable，五服务共享 venv 起栈）
- [x] 壳测试 118/118；服务测试与基线持平（零回归）
- [ ] 真机 GUI 安装三档验证（全新首启/热启动/attach）+ 主对话/记忆/skill 冒烟 —— 待装机
- [ ] W3/W4 后续波次（对齐去重 + locales）另出 release4

### 附加信息

代码在分支 `sizeopt/f26-6to2`（commit `d2fd4f51` W1 + `1dc952a0` W2），PR 待提交；审计证据五件套在开发仓 `f26-size-analysis/`（import 扫描与反向依赖链）。英文版见 #808。到 200 MB 需 Python 环境联网安装的产品形态变更，不在本 issue 范围。
807.title: [Feature]: 安装包体积优化（f26 797.6 MiB → 578.0 MiB，-27.5%，终版已出）

808.author: qingkwl
808.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

The Windows desktop installer weighed **797.6 MiB** at the f26 baseline (`836,309,864 B`). A payload audit (per-package import scans plus reverse-dependency tracing — evidence linked below) confirmed roughly **1.2 GB of uncompressed dead weight**: dependency packages never imported by runtime code, giant binaries pulled in by extras (claude.exe 237 MB, the codex toolchain ~437 MB, the playwright driver 88 MB, uv.exe 49 MB), lint-group dev tools (mypy/ruff/pylint ~40 MB), transitive dependencies of chromadb/jinja2/a2ui (kubernetes 37 MB, onnxruntime 42 MB, babel 32 MB, google_adk ~20 MB), and heavy duplication across the five Python service envs (pydantic/fastapi/uvicorn each stored five times).

This issue records the optimization that has already landed (f26 → **578.0 MiB, −27.5%**, final release4). All four waves are done (W1 dead-weight / W2 env merge / W3 version alignment / W4 gates + locales). Hard constraints (owner decision): **offline double-click install, zero network at first run, no first-run slowdown**; the W15 all-baked pyc precompile design is untouched.

### Design Ideas

Wave-based; every wave ships its own installer, is verified independently, and can be reverted alone.

**W1 — slim the JW payload + codex vendor (done, −214 MiB → 613.4 MiB)**
0. Units: the MB figures below are **uncompressed payload**; the installer is 7z-compressed (f26 overall retention 29.6%). This wave removed 1041 MB uncompressed, which showed up as −184 MiB in the installer (measured effective retention of the removed slice: 18.6% — the slice is dominated by .py sources such as claude_agent_sdk, which compress better than the payload average).
1. `scripts/jiuwenswarm.sh`: `uv sync` gains `--no-default-groups` (lint/test groups no longer enter the runtime venv; **measured contribution ~40 MB**: mypy 12 + mypyc 5 + the fb62009__mypyc .pyd 19 + pylint/astroid/codespell etc.); also fixes the hard-coded POSIX `jw_bin` that broke setup under Git Bash (now picks `Scripts/` by existence).
2. claude/codex extras close (the bulk of this wave): a fresh `uv sync` never installs extras — the old tree was an `--all-extras` leftover. Measured old-vs-new venv diff: `claude_agent_sdk` (238 MB) no longer installed (JW's `external_cli_runtime` detects via `find_spec`, so absence degrades to "not installed" in the UI); playwright (104 MB) then moved out of main deps by 0018. Together the two steps measured 1578→895 MB on the venv.
3. New `win_desktop/scripts/lib/payload-slim.mjs`: assemble-time whitelist sweep for transitive deps uv cannot exclude (kubernetes/onnxruntime/babel/google_adk/mypy family/claude_agent_sdk/playwright/uv plus venv `Scripts` launchers). Every rule carries an audit citation and unit tests (5/5); backstop philosophy — fresh trees never install them, stale trees get swept.
4. assemble drops the `@openai/codex` vendored native toolchain (~437 MB uncompressed): verified the SDK never touches the binaries at import time (it resolves them at `Codex` construction), so api startup is unaffected; only a codex specialist run errors at use time.
5. JW patch chain gains `0018-desktop-slim-deps`: playwright/uv removed from main deps in pyproject (uv.lock regenerated into the patch; chain 13→15); `huawei_selectors.py` top-level import degrades to `Any` via try/except (−156 MB; every runtime call site was verified to be a function-level lazy import / pip fallback).

**W2 — merge five service envs into one uv workspace (done, −30 MiB → 583.3 MiB)**
1. A virtual workspace at the repo root (`[tool.uv.workspace]`, five members); the five per-service `uv.lock` files are deleted; a single lock resolves 68 packages with every conflict taking the highest compatible version (fastapi 0.162 / websockets 17.4 / pydantic 2.14 / numpy 2.5.4 / pandas 3.1).
2. `start-stack.mjs`: five per-service syncs → one workspace sync (with the evolve `candidates` extra); all four service pythons resolve to `envs/sd-services`.
3. `bootstrap.ts` `venvNames` → `["sd-services"]`; `assemble-backend.mjs` `VENV_NAMES` likewise; payload envs-template 525.3→423.7 MB.
4. Trade-off note (revisiting the F10.9 "never merge venvs" rule): after highest-version unification the only hard conflict is websockets (JW cap `<16`), handled by the W3 patch; a single venv means any dependency upgrade needs full-stack regression — accepted.

**W3/W4 (done, release4 = 578.0 MiB)**: JW patch 0019 aligns versions — websockets cap `<16`→`<18` (17 is pinned out by google-genai `<17`; every call site was audited to carry a legacy→new-API fallback, so the lock stays on 15.0.1 with zero behaviour change); numpy/pandas aligned with the workspace (2.5.4/3.1.0). Cross-venv identical content measured at 59.9 MB, but hardlink dedup was closed as ineffective for installer size (7z solid-window mechanics + venv isolation). assemble gained four hard gates: JW precompile failure now fails the build (fixes the silent pyc-skip class), payload import self-check (A1), a required-files manifest (A2), and payload size always printed (A4); Electron locales trimmed 55→3 paks (en-US/zh-CN/zh-TW, afterPack hook). Remaining levers pending decision: evolve `candidates` extra out of the installer (−~25 MiB, /evolve unavailable), Feishu `lark_oapi` 95 MB, imageio_ffmpeg 84 MB / matplotlib 23 MB reference audits.

### Involved Public APIs

None. All changes are packaging/build-chain (assemble, setup scripts, JW patch chain) and desktop-shell-internal paths (bootstrap env vars). Capabilities that become unavailable after the cuts, each with a fallback and none on the first-run or main-dialog path: the claude CLI runtime, codex specialist, the scrape functions of two browser-based skills, and JW's uv acceleration for self-upgrade/extension installs (pip fallback).

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

- `scripts/`: jiuwenswarm.sh (setup flags), start-stack.mjs (envs resolution), lib/stack-platform.mjs (fixes `.cmd` spawn EINVAL, Node ≥20.12 CVE-2024-27980).
- `win_desktop/scripts`: assemble-backend.mjs (sweep hooks); new lib/payload-slim.mjs + test/payload-slim.test.ts.
- `win_desktop/src`: bootstrap.ts (venvNames, PAPER_PYTHON_PATH).
- `jiuwen_swarm/patches/workswarm0.2.6/`: new 0018-desktop-slim-deps.patch (manifest 15).
- Service sources under `services/*/src`: zero changes; the only JW source change inside the patch is the playwright degradation of two skill scripts.

### Test Design and Test Plan

- Unit: `win_desktop` shell tests 118/118 (new payload-slim 5/5; bootstrap fixtures rebuilt around the shared venv layout).
- Service suites: gateway 30/30, paper 2/2, memory-graph 109 passed (78 errors all "needs a live Neo4j" — pre-existing environmental), evolve 335 passed / 33 failed — **byte-identical failure set to the f26 baseline tree** (pre-existing Windows no-sandbox issue; zero regression).
- Full-stack smoke: start-stack (shared venv) brings the stack up; adapter `/agent/info` returns `reachable: true`.
- Payload spot checks (every wave): 7/7 dead-weight packages absent, 29087 JW pyc files, manifest contains 0018, live packages retained (numpy/pandas/transformers/chromadb/faiss/lark_oapi/openjiuwen).
- Installer measurements: v0.2 = 613.4 MiB; v0.3 = 583.3 MiB; release4 = 578.0 MiB (all measured, not projected).

### Acceptance Criteria

- [x] f26 797.6 MiB → release4 ≤ 600 MiB (measured 578.0 MiB, −27.5%)
- [x] Dead-weight packages verified absent one by one in the payload (7/7); live packages retained
- [x] pyc precompile fully on disk (29908→29087 files; W15 first-run speedup intact)
- [x] Full-stack smoke passes (adapter↔JW reachable; five services boot from the shared venv)
- [x] Shell tests 118/118; service suites at baseline parity (zero regression)
- [ ] Real-machine GUI install, three startup profiles (fresh first run / warm start / attach) + main-dialog/memory/skill smoke — pending install test
- [ ] W3/W4 follow-up waves (alignment dedup + locales) ship as release4

### Additional Information

Code lives on branch `sizeopt/f26-6to2` (commits `d2fd4f51` W1 + `1dc952a0` W2); PR to follow. The five-document audit evidence (import scans and reverse-dependency chains) is under `f26-size-analysis/` in the working tree. Chinese version: #807. Reaching 200 MB requires a product-level switch to an online installer for the Python environment — explicitly out of scope here.

809.body:
## What happens

A JSON artifact whose document carries an integer above `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER` is shown with a **different value** in the preview. The table cell and both text views go through IEEE-754 doubles, so the digits are replaced by the nearest representable neighbour.

Reproduced on `main` at `8708320f80af8a72ea96653e2a71bd89d83a6850` against `services/api/src/artifact-dashboard.ts` (probe drives the real `buildArtifactVersionPreview`, fake store/recorder only supply the stored bytes):

```
# TABLE {"mode":"dataset-table","columns":["sample_id","label"],"rows":[["9007199254740992","x"]],"raw":"[\\n  {\\n    \\"sample_id\\": 9007199254740992,\\n    \\"label\\": \\"x\\"\\n  }\\n]"}
# RAW "[\\n  {\\n    \\"sample_id\\": 9007199254740992\\n  }\\n]"
# SOURCE {"mode":"json-source","source":"{\\n  \\"run_id\\": 12345678901234567000\\n}","parsed":true}
not ok 1 - a record table keeps an integer id above 2^53 exact
  expected: '9007199254740993'
  actual: '9007199254740992'
not ok 2 - the raw JSON view keeps an integer id above 2^53 exact
  expected: true
  actual: false
not ok 3 - a scalar-id document keeps its literal digits in the JSON source view
  expected: true
  actual: false
# tests 3
# pass 0
# fail 3
```

Input documents: `[{"sample_id":9007199254740993,"label":"x"}]` and `{"run_id":12345678901234567890}`.

## Why it matters

Sample, run and registration identifiers routinely exceed 2^53. The viewer shows `...992` for `...993`, and the "Raw JSON" pane re-serialises the same wrong value, so the user copies a plausible but different identifier into their analysis. The same data stored as `.csv` goes through the string path and stays exact, so the two previews of one value disagree.

## Where

`services/api/src/artifact-dashboard.ts` (display layer only):

- `recordArrayTable` — the table cell is `String(value)`, after the document was parsed into doubles.
- `buildJsonPreview` — `rawJson` is `JSON.stringify(parsed, null, 2)`, i.e. re-serialised from the rounded value.
- `buildJsonPreview` — the `json-source` fallback is `JSON.stringify(parsed, null, 2)` too.

## Expected

- A record array keeps each integer literal exactly as written: the cell for `9007199254740993` reads `9007199254740993`.
- `rawJson.source` and the `json-source` view echo the stored document (BOM-stripped the same way #805 does), not a re-serialisation, so both stay exact.
- Ordinary values do not regress: `42` still renders as `42`, strings and nested objects unchanged, and the existing `dashboard.test.ts` cases stay green.

## Scope / non-goals

- One file, `services/api/src/artifact-dashboard.ts`. No change to `packages/artifact-manager`, the job shape, the CAS or the stored artifact.
- The UTF-8 BOM handling added by #805 stays exactly as it is; this is about numeric literals, not the leading marker.
- The CSV/TSV path is out of scope (it already yields strings).
- If the fix turns out to need a change outside this file, stop and report instead of widening the PR.

812.body:
## What this adds

Two things, on top of the Evolve that already ships. Everything else stays as it is.

1. A score that needs this conversation's runner runs on that runner. Each candidate gets its own sandbox there. The sandbox has no network. The cards already selected for the runner are attached only when this score needs them. The search itself stays next to the API: it proposes candidates and keeps the archive.
2. The scorecard can name the fields a candidate may change. Any other change is rejected. If the scorecard names no fields, the search stays the free program search it is today.

## What stays the same

A run that does not use a runner still scores in the local sandbox. `vendor/puct/search.py` is not changed. Product code, unit tests, and system tests do not name a stand-in model or scene. A later end-to-end case would be a separate change.

## How a score is recorded

The program that computes the score is fixed and runs on the runner. The candidate only supplies the fields it is allowed to change. A number printed by the candidate is not the score.

- Still queued or running: wait. No score. That same edit does not take another search slot.
- Failed, cancelled, or no result: no score. Do not write 0.
- Finished: write the number the fixed program returned.

One candidate is one job, with its own execution id. Queue time counts toward that job's time limit. At the limit, cancel the job.

## Done when

- [ ] A search that does not use a runner and does not name editable fields behaves as it does on `main`, including the local sandbox.
- [ ] A search that uses a runner scores each candidate in a sandbox on that runner, with no network. Cards are attached only when the score needs them.
- [ ] A waiting, failed, or missing result has no score, and it is not stored as 0.
- [ ] A candidate that changes a field outside the named list is rejected before scoring.
- [ ] `pnpm evolve:test` passes. The inner result is not published to the skill library.

---

## 加什么

在现有 Evolve 上加两件事，其它保持原样。

1. 这次评分要用本轮对话选中的 Runner 时，评分就在那台机器上做。每个候选单独一个沙箱，沙箱不上网。只有这次评分要用卡时，才把已经勾选的卡放进去。搜索本身仍在 API 旁边：它负责提出候选、保存档案。
2. scorecard 可以写明候选允许改哪些字段。改了别的就拒绝。没写的话，搜索仍是现在这种自由改程序。

## 什么不变

没用 Runner 的 Run，仍在本机沙箱里评分。`vendor/puct/search.py` 不动。正式代码、单元测试、系统测试里不写某个具体模型或场景。以后若要端到端用例，另开一次改动。

## 分数怎么记

算分的程序是固定的，跑在 Runner 上。候选只提供允许改的那些字段。候选自己打印的数字不算分数。

- 还在排队或运行：等。不记分。同一次改动不再占一个新名额。
- 失败、取消或没有结果：不记分，也不写成 0。
- 完成：记下固定程序返回的数字。

一个候选一次作业，各自一个执行编号。排队时间算进这次作业的时限。到点就取消。

## 完成标准

- [ ] 不用 Runner、也没有点名字段的搜索，行为和 `main` 上一样，包括本机沙箱。
- [ ] 用了 Runner 的搜索，每个候选在那台 Runner 的沙箱里评分，不上网。要用卡才绑卡。
- [ ] 等待、失败或没有结果时不记分，也不写成 0。
- [ ] 改了点名之外的字段，评分之前就拒绝。
- [ ] `pnpm evolve:test` 通过。这一次的结果不写入技能库。

## What happened

On 2026-11-03 the model gateway started answering `503 Service is too busy` (`type: service_unavailable_error`, wrapped by the product as `[181001] model call failed … model_gateway_error`). Every queued pull request then failed L3 real E2E in the merge queue, and the queue drained nothing.

Three merge-queue runs from the same window, three different revisions, the same two jobs red (`L3 real E2E / Real E2E (basic)` and `L3 real E2E / Account for real cases`, then `merge-gate`):

| PR | merge_group run | merge queue head | L3 basic | Account |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| #810 | [41614272116](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/actions/runs/41614272116) | `b4379ac3` | failure | failure |
| #810 | [41613281893](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/actions/runs/41613281893) | `03b27a13` | failure | failure |
| #715 | [41614268417](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/actions/runs/41614268417) | `68ddebba` | failure | failure |
| #775 | [41614267932](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/actions/runs/41614267932) | `f727b104` | failure | failure |

The verdict for #810's run [41614272116](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/actions/runs/41614272116) (`real-e2e-verdict` artifact, `verdict.json`):

```
status FAIL, exitCode 1
planned 9, reported 9, executed 9
passed 1, failed 8, skipped 0
providerFaults 0, providerFaultRetries 0
problems: "basic: SHARD_FAILED", then 8 × "FAIL: <case key>"
```

So the gateway outage is reported as a **product failure**, not as a provider fault, and the retry path never engages. That contradicts the guarantee #548/#232 established: a provider fault is reported as `PROVIDER_FAULT: <case>` and never as `FAIL: <case>`.

## Why the fault is lost

The gateway text reaches the case as the assertion's own message. Both journeys do:

- `test/journey-basic-real-api.spec.ts:100` — `expect(terminal.status,terminal.error).toBe('completed');`
- `test/journey-runner-recovery-real.spec.ts:109` — same line

The second argument means one Playwright `error.message` carries **both** the gateway's 503 and the assertion block. From the L3 job log of run 41614268417:

```
Error: [181001] model call failed, reason: openAI API async stream error: InternalServerError: Error code: 503 -
  {'error': {'message': 'Model request failed with status 503: {"error":{"message":"Service is too busy. ...",
  "type":"service_unavailable_error","code":"service_unavailable_error"}}', 'type': 'model_gateway_error'}}
expect(received).toBe(expected) // Object.is equality
Expected: "completed"
Received: "failed"
```

`detectProviderFault` (`test/support/tagged/provider-fault.mjs`) classifies the first half as a fault and then discards it because the same string matches `PRODUCT_REPORT` (`\bexpected\s*:|\breceived\s*:|\bassertion\b`) — the veto that protects a product failure which merely *quotes* a status also swallows a status the gateway itself produced. Reproduced by replaying the classifier on the two halves of that text:

```
gateway text alone          => {"code":"provider-server-error","status":503}
assertion block alone       => null
gateway text + assertion    => null      <-- the shape that actually occurs
```

`detectProviderFaultFromErrors` makes it worse for a case with several messages: it returns a fault only when **every** message classifies, so one assertion-only message vetoes a case that also carries the gateway's 503.

## Impact

- An outage is attributed to the pull request under review; in the queue it reads as a product regression for every candidate at once.
- `providerFaultRetries` stays 0, so the bounded early repeat that #548 added for exactly this situation never runs.
- No queued PR can merge while the provider is down (see the open question below, which is separate from the classification bug).

## Proposed fix

1. Let the gateway's own vocabulary win over the assertion wrapper: if `GATEWAY_CONTEXT` (`181001`, `model call failed`, `openai api`, `chat/completions`) and a 5xx status are present, classify as a provider fault even when `Expected:` / `Received:` appear. Keep `PRODUCT_REPORT` superior when the text quotes a status only — the existing `provider-fault.test.mjs` cases pin that direction and should stay green.
2. In `detectProviderFaultFromErrors`, treat the case as a fault when at least one message classifies and no message reports a product delivery miss, instead of requiring every message to classify.

This does not soften the gate floor from #548: a remaining provider fault still exits non-zero and still is not a pass. It only makes the failure named correctly, so the retry path can run and the queue can tell an outage from a regression.

## Open question (policy, not part of the fix)

#548 deliberately keeps `PROVIDER_FAULT` non-passing, so a full gateway outage still blocks the merge queue with no escape for any candidate. Should the merge-queue L3 profile get one bounded re-enqueue — or a neutral/skipped result — when the verdict is entirely provider faults? No proposal here beyond the question; the floor itself is not being reopened.

## Acceptance

- A case whose error message contains `[181001] model call failed … 503` **and** `Expected: "completed"` / `Received: "failed"` is counted as `PROVIDER_FAULT`, and the verdict reports `providerFaults > 0`.
- A product-only failure (a delivery miss with no gateway text) still counts as `FAIL` and still turns the verdict into `FAIL`.
- `node --test .ci/provider-fault.test.mjs` stays green, plus a new case for the mixed gateway-plus-assertion shape.
